description: Upgrades a domain controller using the Microsoft-prescribed parallel paradigm: promote a new DC at the target Windows Server version, wait for AD replication to converge, transfer FSMO roles, then demote the old DC. Replaces deprecated in-place DC upgrade. Fully reversible.

new_dc_asset_id.label: New DC Asset ID
new_dc_asset_id.description: Nexplane asset ID of the new domain controller (must already be joined to the domain)

new_dc_hostname.label: New DC Hostname
new_dc_hostname.description: FQDN or IP of the new domain controller

target_os_version.label: Target OS Version
target_os_version.description: Windows Server version of the new DC (e.g. 2025)

transfer_fsmo.label: Transfer FSMO Roles
transfer_fsmo.description: Transfer FSMO roles from old to new DC (default: true)

demote_old_dc.label: Demote Old DC
demote_old_dc.description: Demote the old DC after FSMO transfer (default: true)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight only — no promotion or demotion

rollback.description: FILO rollback: (1) re-promote old DC, (2) seize FSMO roles back to old DC, (3) demote new DC.

steps.description: Verify new DC is online, domain-joined, and reachable
Install ADDS role and run dcpromo on new DC
Wait for AD replication to converge on new DC
Transfer FSMO roles to new DC
Demote old DC by removing ADDS role
